question: Which Marvel star just secretly ended her marriage?
story: Julia Garner, the Emmy winner from Ozark who just lit up screens as the Silver Surfer in Fantastic Four, has quietly separated from her husband after six years of marriage. Her husband is Mark Foster, the frontman of Foster the People, the guy behind that inescapable song Pumped Up Kicks. According to People, sources confirmed the split in mid July, and fans are stunned. These two kept one of Hollywood's most low key marriages, barely ever posting about each other. The first clue actually came from her hands. Julia was recently spotted in both Paris and Los Angeles with no wedding ring, and the internet immediately started whispering. Here is the wild part. They first met back in 2013 at Sundance, but did not start dating until years later, reconnecting through a single Instagram message. Six years married, and it ended just as quietly as it began.
